# STAR CHAIN LABS

> Architects of Intelligent Digital Ecosystems. We build mission-critical enterprise software, decentralized networks, custom CRM/ERP platforms, and autonomous AI automation.

Star Chain Labs is a premier digital engineering studio founded by Aniket Pandey (CEO) and Harshit Pandey (CTO). Star Chain Labs combines enterprise-grade distributed systems, human-centered UI/UX, real-time 3D WebGL experiences, and cryptographic protocols to engineer scalable digital systems.

## Primary Resource

- [Star Chain Labs](https://starchainlabs.com/): Official portal featuring core solutions, capabilities, interactive system dashboards, case studies, technology constellation, and direct engineering consultation.

## Core Pillars & Solutions

1. **Digital Products & Platforms**: Consumer and enterprise web applications, high-concurrency mobile platforms (iOS/Android), multi-tenant SaaS architecture, interactive 3D WebGL experiences.
2. **Business & Enterprise Systems**: Custom CRM pipelines, ERP resource planning engines, HRMS workforce systems, supply chain & multi-vendor marketplaces, high-volume transactional billing systems.
3. **Intelligent Technology & Automation**: Autonomous AI agents, LLM & RAG architectures, document understanding, intelligent triage pipelines, robotic process automation (RPA), algorithmic trading systems.
4. **Infrastructure, Web3 & Emerging Tech**: Smart contracts (Solidity/Rust), decentralized identity protocols, multi-tier value distribution engines, zero-trust cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP), smart contract security audits.

## Flagship Systems & Case Studies

- **Santiria Samadhan**: Civic Grievance Triage & Resolution Platform serving 2M+ citizens across 40+ departments with 68% triage latency reduction, GIS heatmapping, and biometric citizen auth.
- **AuraFlow ERP**: Multi-Tenant Cloud Enterprise Resource Planning platform managing $120M+ annualized GMV with sub-second inventory sync, automated GST billing, and multi-warehouse routing.
- **Nexis Protocol**: Decentralized Identity & Credential Verification Protocol handling 850k+ verifiable credentials with zero-knowledge zk-SNARK cryptographic proofs.
- **Krypton Network**: Decentralized Multi-Tier Affiliate & Network Distribution Engine processing $48M+ automated on-chain payouts across 12 tiers with gas-optimized smart contracts.

- **Harshit Pandey**: Co-Founder & Chief Technology Officer. Directing distributed systems architecture, blockchain protocols, and AI research engineering.
